141:t_1:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... Those Imperial bastards gave up on Tokyo, where $$ゼロ$$ is, and set their sights on Kansai.」

141:t_1:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They are targeting this $$厳島$$ Base, the stronghold for the defense of Kansai.」

141:t_1:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Four hours from now, a large $$サイデリアル$$ force will converge on this place.」

141:t_1:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But $$厳島$$ is the anchor of the heart for the people of $$新日本$$.」

141:t_1:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$藤堂鏡志朗$$'s 'Miracle of $$厳島$$'... The only place where this country won a victory in its old war with the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$...」

141:t_1:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We can't hand that $$厳島$$ over to invaders...!」

141:t_1:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The enemy may have chosen this place as its target to exploit that psychological effect.」

141:t_1:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If so, that guy is one hell of a smart bastard. Not that I like him.」

141:t_1:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then we have no choice but to meet them head-on, ready to die fighting. Even if we lose, we make them pay a fitting price and show them our will to fight.」

141:t_1:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「True, in that case Japanese pride would be preserved. But seen from the larger picture, that sacrifice can only be called useless.」

141:t_1:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I understand what you're trying to say. But what's holding this country up right now is stubbornness and pride.」

141:t_1:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we lose that, it won't last long anyway.」

141:t_1:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even if it won't last long, if we can buy even a little time, a chance to turn the situation around will be born.」

141:t_1:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm not saying dying fighting is the best way either. ...But there are things that, once lost, can never be recovered...」

141:t_1:20.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we lose our spiritual pillar now, that's the same as defeat from that very moment.」

141:t_1:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah... We've both said what we had to say. All that's left is to let the Captain decide.」

141:t_1:23.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Captain... Let us hear your opinion.」

141:t_2:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We confirmed it in North America as well. Part of the $$地球連邦軍$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ have gone over to the Empire and are fighting alongside it as a joint front.」

141:t_2:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「What we feared has become reality...」

141:t_2:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To break this situation, we will cooperate with the regular forces and take on the assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

141:t_2:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$'s most important strategic stronghold, where the $$レイライン$$s of every continent converge...」

141:t_2:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can take just that, we should be able to even up the war situation on the North American front.」

141:t_2:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. I wish $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ the best of luck.」

141:t_2:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We will be sure to win and bring you good news.」

141:t_2:12.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ordinarily, we should be taking part in the North American front as well, but...」

141:t_2:13.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Leaving $$新日本$$ right now would be far too dangerous.」

141:t_2:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「Call $$ゼロ$$. If we don't take countermeasures soon, it may become something we can't undo.」

141:t_2:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Damn... If it's going to be like this, even facing $$ダバラーン$$, who only comes at us with brute force, would have been better...」

141:t_2:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「...What do you mean, the volunteer forces everywhere are in a state of confusion...!?」

141:t_2:22.en:
$$スザク$$
「They say people are shaken that part of the $$地球連邦軍$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ cooperated with the $$新地球皇国$$ to attack $$新日本$$.」

141:t_2:23.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This country has been invaded by other nations in the past. Aliens would be one thing, but the fact that they were attacked by fellow Earthlings must be a huge shock.」

141:t_2:24.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Wait a moment...! The battle of $$厳島$$ only just ended, so how has the news already spread!?」

141:t_2:25.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Calm down, $$ヒルデ$$. Naturally, considering the psychological impact, we treated this matter as top secret.」

141:t_2:26.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But the fact is, word has already reached even ordinary citizens...」

141:t_2:28.en:
$$五飛$$
「We should see it as information being leaked on someone's orders.」

141:t_2:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「Those bastards...! They knew about the wounds in the hearts of the people of $$新日本$$ and drew up an operation like this...!」

141:t_2:32.en:
$$五飛$$
「As far as they're concerned, if they could use Earth's forces to take $$厳島$$, the spiritual pillar of $$新日本$$, all the better...」

141:t_2:33.en:
$$五飛$$
「And even if they couldn't take it, they must have figured that merely shaking people's morale would be enough.」

141:t_2:34.en:
$$カレン$$
「Unforgivable...! Using even our anger and sorrow in their operation...!」

141:t_2:36.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Their method this time... It's clearly different from the Empire's so far...」

141:t_2:37.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$新日本$$ has fought to this day on the high morale of the people who live there...」

141:t_2:38.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And their operation is aimed at breaking exactly that... A fearsome enemy.」

141:t_2:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So you and the others were fighting in $$新日本$$ too, $$竜馬$$.」

141:t_2:40.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Given the situation, yeah. I figured I'd go straight to the nearest hot spot.」

141:t_2:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$大貫$$ was worried about you, too.」

141:t_2:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「When peace comes, I'll go back to $$陣代高校$$. Life there was exciting enough, too.」

141:t_2:43.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#bigo$$, $$キリコ$$ and I joined the defense of $$新日本$$ at $$ゼロ$$'s invitation.」

141:t_2:45.en:
$n
「I had no idea you were fighting so close by.」

141:t_2:46.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That can't be helped. On top of communications between regions being cut off, everyone had their hands full with what was happening around them.」

141:t_2:47.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even I am in a situation where you could call me one soldier rather than a Negotiator.」

141:t_2:48.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Is that all right with you, $$ロジャー$$?」

141:t_2:49.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Of course I am not satisfied with the present state of affairs. But aggression has already gone beyond the stage where its rights and wrongs can be debated with words.」

141:t_2:50.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, by $$ロジャー$$'s law, I intend to face them with the power called $$ビッグオー$$.」

141:t_2:51.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Spare me the excuses. All it means is that a man can talk with his fists too.」

141:t_2:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「When I am swept up in your pace, I come close to losing my pride in my own profession.」

141:t_2:53.en:
$$五飛$$
「I wish I could settle things in both reason and emotion, as you two do.」

141:t_2:54.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But for many people, that is difficult. Especially for the people of $$新日本$$, who carry wounds in their hearts.」

141:t_2:55.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Anxiety turns into distrust and breeds suspicion, and that gradually eats away at people's hearts...」

141:t_2:56.en:
$$カレン$$
「If this bleak atmosphere keeps taking over $$新日本$$...」

141:t_2:57.en:
$$スザク$$
「We won't be able to fight as one united front like before...」

141:t_2:58.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So that is the enemy's real aim.」

141:t_2:59.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn...! It's like a poison that works on you bit by bit...!」
